mettle.feedback.defense.roll_with_the_bl: Roll with the Blow · %s held back
mettle.perk.defense.armour_training.desc: Worn armour weighs %s%% less for you.
mettle.perk.defense.battle_worn.descript: Armour you wear never breaks: at 1 durability it stops wearing and protects at half strength until repaired.
mettle.perk.defense.bulwark.description: Your raised shield covers your sides too: it blocks anything not coming from behind you.
mettle.perk.defense.guardian.description: While your shield is up, friends within 4 blocks take 40%% less damage, and hostiles within 8 blocks that attack them turn on you.
mettle.perk.defense.hold_the_line.descri: Every hit you take while standing still adds +1 armour for 5 s, up to +5.
mettle.perk.defense.juggernaut.descripti: In full armour nothing knocks you back, and sprinting into a mob bowls it over: 4 damage, thrown 3 blocks, dazed for 1 s.
mettle.perk.defense.last_stand.descripti: Once every 10 minutes, a killing blow leaves you at 1 heart with 4 s of Resistance IV instead.
mettle.perk.defense.marching_order.descr: Worn armour counts only half towards your load.
mettle.perk.defense.mender.description: Armour and shields you wear lose durability 30%% more slowly.
mettle.perk.defense.perfect_block.descri: A hit that lands within 0.25 s of raising your shield is reflected: the attacker takes half of it.
mettle.perk.defense.pincushion.descripti: Half the arrows you block end up in your inventory.
mettle.perk.defense.pincushion.hint: A good shield keeps what it catches.
mettle.perk.defense.roll_with_the_blow.d: A quarter of every hit you take is dealt over the next 4 s instead of all at once.
mettle.perk.defense.roll_with_the_blow.h: Taught by a city’s guard captain, or found in The Citadel Drill.
mettle.perk.defense.second_wind.descript: Once every 5 minutes, dropping below 4 hearts gives you Regeneration II for 5 s.
mettle.perk.defense.shield_bash.descript: Hit a mob within 0.5 s of lowering your shield to shove it back 3 blocks and daze it for 1 s.
mettle.perk.defense.shield_up.descriptio: Your shield raises instantly, and nothing knocks you back while you block.
mettle.perk.defense.still_standing.descr: The first hit over 10 damage you take each minute is reduced by a third.
mettle.perk.defense.unbowed.description: In full armour, poison, wither, slowness and weakness on you last half as long.
